refund_policy: No refunds once evaluation credentials are emailed (all sales final). The evaluation fee is refunded with the trader's 4th successful profit-split payout; not refunded if the account is hard-breached before then.
payout_methods: Rise (payouts of $500+; bank transfer or crypto)
scaling_plan: 12% return within a 3-month period → balance +25% of initial account size, subject to review; up to $4,000,000 max allocation (Aqua Elite progression programme on top)
ea_bots: allowed (as part of your own strategy; tick scalping/HFT/arbitrage bots prohibited)
max_risk_per_trade: Funded: max floating loss per trade/position — Instant Standard 1% (three strikes: split 50%, 25%, then breach), Instant Pro 2% (1% on $300K/$400K = permanent breach); WaveStop on some models; max 80% margin usage per trade (profits deducted)
inactivity_rule: At least one trade every 30 days from first trade, otherwise the account is breached
notes: Failed accounts cannot be retried/resumed; a new account must be bought (CFD). Futures widget lists 'Account resets' and 'No Activation Fee' but no reset price was captured. 3% processing fee on all payouts; first two rewards capped at $10,000 each on $100K+ accounts. Paid add-ons: Lifetime 100% split, Rewards in 7 Days (non-instant), Rewards On Demand (instant), Swap Free. Martingale allowed; stop loss not required. Copy trading allowed between own AquaFunded accounts and from own external accounts. Trades held under 2 minutes may be treated as tick scalping (profit removal on funded). Help centre documents a Pay After Pass model ($5 evaluation + one-time activation fee after passing, e.g. $200 on 50K) not shown in the homepage widget.
